what_it_does: Explores recent concrete experiences through neutral questions
best_for: Motivations, context, workarounds, and decision criteria
watch_out: Avoid leading questions and hypothetical preference as evidence

what_it_does: Organises what users say, think, do, and feel while marking inference
best_for: Synthesising several observations into a shared view
watch_out: Do not invent thoughts or feelings

what_it_does: Maps steps, channels, emotions, friction, and recovery across time
best_for: Experiences spanning several stages or touchpoints
watch_out: Anchor stages and pain points in observed evidence

what_it_does: Frames the progress a person seeks and alternatives competing for the job
best_for: Understanding the outcome behind a request
watch_out: Do not reduce the job to a requested feature

what_it_does: Observes real behaviour, environment constraints, and workarounds
best_for: Unspoken process or environmental constraints
watch_out: Record behaviour separately from interpretation

what_it_does: Groups observations to expose patterns, contradictions, and minority cases
best_for: Finding structure in a body of research
watch_out: Do not force disagreement into one theme

what_it_does: Combines a specific user, need, and evidence-backed insight into one design challenge
best_for: Creating a precise problem frame
watch_out: Avoid generic users and circular reasoning

what_it_does: Turns an agreed challenge into open solution questions
best_for: Opening solution space without choosing a feature
watch_out: Do not hide the preferred solution inside the question

what_it_does: Uses rapid sketching to push beyond the obvious first concept
best_for: Breaking fixation on one interface or service idea
watch_out: Eight is a forcing device, not a quality target

what_it_does: Transforms an existing concept through substitute, combine, adapt, modify, repurpose, eliminate, and reverse lenses
best_for: Improving or challenging something concrete
watch_out: Use only lenses that create meaningful alternatives

what_it_does: Transfers a useful principle from another domain into the current problem
best_for: Escaping category conventions
watch_out: Translate the principle rather than copying surface form

what_it_does: Temporarily inverts beliefs or conventions to reveal new options
best_for: Testing whether constraints are real or customary
watch_out: Separate real constraints from convenient beliefs

what_it_does: Represents sequence, hierarchy, and comprehension with rough screens or cards
best_for: Cheap testing of flow and information order
watch_out: Keep it rough enough that participants will criticise it

what_it_does: Shows context, actions, and outcomes over time
best_for: Testing an end-to-end experience or service moment
watch_out: Include failure and recovery, not only the happy path

what_it_does: Acts out service interactions, roles, and handoffs
best_for: Testing human or operational interactions
watch_out: Define roles and observable breakdowns first

what_it_does: Simulates automation manually so the experience can be tested early
best_for: Learning before the underlying system exists
watch_out: Disclose simulation appropriately and protect participants

what_it_does: Observes a participant attempting neutral tasks while the researcher probes carefully
best_for: Finding comprehension, navigation, and interaction friction
watch_out: Do not teach the intended path

what_it_does: Designs the cheapest credible test of one critical belief
best_for: Reducing a specific uncertainty quickly
watch_out: Define what would contradict the assumption in advance

what_it_does: Separates observations, questions, ideas, and requested changes after a session
best_for: Organising varied feedback without flattening it
watch_out: Do not let stated preference outweigh observed behaviour

what_it_does: Maps frontstage experience, backstage work, systems, and handoffs
best_for: Aligning a service across people, process, and technology
watch_out: Map evidence and failure points, not an idealised service

what_it_does: Runs a limited real-world version with measures, safety limits, and stop criteria
best_for: Learning in real conditions before broad rollout
watch_out: Keep scope and rollback explicit

what_it_does: Defines behavioural, outcome, and feedback signals after launch
best_for: Checking whether the experience creates intended progress
watch_out: Prefer outcome signals over vanity metrics
